ALL_MATTERS_MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.title: Mutagenic Strength
ALL_MATTERS_MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.descripti: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [red]Mutagenic Decay[/red]. At the end of your third turn, lose [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
ALL_MATTERS_MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.flavor: Residual power from a genetic experiment.
ALL_MATTERS_NECRONOMICON.title: Necronomicon
ALL_MATTERS_NECRONOMICON.description: On pickup, obtain [red]Necronomicurse[/red]. The first time you play an [gold]Attack[/gold] costing {Energy:energyIcons()} or more each turn, play it twice.
ALL_MATTERS_NECRONOMICON.flavor: Only a fool would try to command such evil power.
ALL_MATTERS_NILRYS_CODEX.title: Nilry's Codex
ALL_MATTERS_NILRYS_CODEX.description: At the end of each turn, you may choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random [gold]upgraded[/gold] cards from your character to shuffle into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ALL_MATTERS_NILRYS_CODEX.flavor: Compiled by the infamous game master himself.
ALL_MATTERS_ENCHIRIDION.title: Enchiridion
ALL_MATTERS_ENCHIRIDION.description: At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Power[/gold] card to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
ALL_MATTERS_ENCHIRIDION.flavor: A legendary journal from an ancient lich.
ALL_MATTERS_BOTTLED_FLAME.title: Bottled Flame
ALL_MATTERS_BOTTLED_FLAME.description: Upon pickup, choose an unbottled Attack without [gold]Innate[/gold]. It gains [gold]Innate[/gold]. While you hold this relic, that card cannot be removed or transformed outside combat.
ALL_MATTERS_BOTTLED_LIGHTNING.title: Bottled Lightning
ALL_MATTERS_BOTTLED_LIGHTNING.descriptio: Upon pickup, choose an unbottled Skill without [gold]Innate[/gold]. It gains [gold]Innate[/gold]. While you hold this relic, that card cannot be removed or transformed outside combat.
ALL_MATTERS_BOTTLED_TORNADO.title: Bottled Tornado
ALL_MATTERS_BOTTLED_TORNADO.description: Upon pickup, choose an unbottled Power without [gold]Innate[/gold]. It gains [gold]Innate[/gold]. While you hold this relic, that card cannot be removed or transformed outside combat.
